item.title: SKADI 1.0.0-beta.22
item.description:
SKADI 1.0.0-beta.22 — Online subtitle search

Built by the coordinated release factory from one tag: Windows, Linux, LG webOS and the Android TV beta APK on GitHub, plus the Fire OS APK for Amazon Live App Testing.

Main changes

  • Online subtitle search through Plex (webOS and Android TV / Fire OS): from the details page before playback and from the player options, by title, in every ISO 639-1 language, with release names and perfect matches highlighted. Remote-friendly keyboard and focus on TV.
  • Android TV / Fire OS: next episode card during the final credits, technical badges under the player title, year and season count under related cards of the TV details page, and the details spotlight no longer overflows onto the rails.
  • webOS (LG C9): more reliable playback (real position reported to Plex, chosen audio track of a direct file, embedded text subtitles, late subtitle tracks, position kept across setting changes, repeated quick seeks), technical badges in the player, smoother remote navigation, larger detail rail captions, "Tout parcourir" grid scrolling, Personnaliser l'accueil grouped by server.
  • Continue Watching (Plex): removing a rewatched episode no longer hides the whole show.
  • Desktop: Video and Audio sections in Settings; selected chips and focused menu entries stay readable.
  • Full details in CHANGELOG.md.

Version and distribution

  • Product version 1.0.0-beta.22, build 56; webOS package version 1.0.56.
  • Android versionCode 56, strictly greater than beta.21 (55). Identifier com.skadi.client and release signing unchanged.
  • GitHub release (arthoriouss/skadi-releases): Windows installer and portable ZIP, Linux .deb, .tar.gz, .rpm and Flatpak, webOS IPK, Android TV beta APK, release-index.json and SHA256SUMS.txt. Windows updates through WinSparkle (appcast.xml).
  • Fire OS: private Actions artifact skadi-fireos-amazon-v1.0.0-beta.22 (APK), uploaded by hand to Amazon Live App Testing. Steps: docs/qualification/fire-os-live-app-testing-beta.22.md.
  • Google Play (Android TV): the store AAB is built locally with scripts/windows/build-android-tv-release.ps1 (production channel, com.skadi.client); the factory APK is the sideload beta (com.skadi.client.beta).

Qualification and limits

  • The webOS IPK is the sideload package; LG Content Store submission stays manual.
